title: Introducing News
author: Raspberry
content:
This is where we deliver news directly to the users. Join our Discord Server below for a much earlier and better news!

https://discord.gg/flarial/

title: 26.40 is not supported
author: The Flarial Client Team
content:
The game have just updated to 26.40, we do not support this version yet.
Please wait for some time for the developers to update the android client.
Join the Discord Server below to get more updates.

https://discord.gg/flarial/
You may still continue using the client on 26.3x versions.
